content.short: Centrifuge is a leading DeFi protocol that tokenizes real-world assets like invoices and mortgages into on-chain NFTs.
content.description:
Centrifuge is a revolutionary protocol that bridges traditional finance and DeFi by bringing real-world assets (RWAs) onto the blockchain. It enables businesses to tokenize assets such as invoices and mortgages into NFTs, which are then used as collateral to access liquidity. Through its Tinlake platform, investors can provide capital to these asset pools, choosing between senior and junior tranches to match their risk and return preferences.

Supported by Centrifuge Chain, a purpose-built Layer 1, the protocol also caters to institutional investors looking to diversify treasuries into credit portfolios. Centrifuge is at the forefront of the RWA movement, unlocking trillions in value for the decentralized economy. By integrating physical assets with DeFi, it provides a stable and scalable source of yield for the entire ecosystem.
